answer_1.quote: We trained a Causal-Aware Empathetic Response model, CAER, using our ECC dataset... the model aims to generate subsequent empathetic responses by effectively integrating contextual and causal information from the dialogue history.

answer_2.quote: The automatic evaluation indicators use PPL, Dist-1/2 and Blue-1/2.

answer_3.quote: We also used the latest release of DeepSeek-v3 (671B) for the same evaluation based on human evaluation metrics, and the results and analysis are shown in Appendix B.5.
methods: automatic evaluation based on human evaluation metrics
Pearson correlation coefficient (PCC) to measure consistency

answer_4.quote: We invited three human evaluators, who had received training in assessing emotional dialogues, to conduct a manual evaluation of 100 randomly selected dialogues from the ECC dataset.
answer_4.guideline: Four evaluation criteria were established: Affective, Relevance, Consistency, and Naturalness, along with an Overall score.
